Overview:

BUILDX is a 36-Hour International-Level Online Hackathon, organized by Code-A-Nova, where developers, innovators, students, and tech enthusiasts come together to transform ideas into working solutions.

With the theme “Build Without Limit”, BUILDX gives participants the freedom to identify real-world problems, design innovative solutions, and build technology-driven products across multiple domains.

Whether you're passionate about AI, Cybersecurity, FinTech, HealthTech, CivicTech, or Open Innovation, BUILDX is your opportunity to build, experiment, collaborate, and showcase what you can create.

WhatsApp Group:

https://chat.whatsapp.com/Ha77thXm83LHrHW76FgC8g?s=cl&p=a&mlu=4&ilr=4

Why Participate in BUILDX?

  • International-Level Online Hackathon
  • 36 Hours of Building
  • Create your own problem statement and solution
  • Work in teams of 3–4 members
  • AI tools are allowed during development
  • Certificates for participants and achievers
  • Goodies for Winners & Runner-Ups
  • Community & Technology Partners
  • Opportunity to showcase your project and innovation

    All the best
